description: This file defines a shared informer factory for Kubernetes custom resources, including configuration options, lifecycle management, and cache synchronization methods.

classes.name: sharedInformerFactory
classes.description: Implementation of the SharedInformerFactory interface, managing informers, lifecycle, and configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts all informers with a stop channel.

methods.name: StartWithContext
methods.description: Starts all informers with a context for cancellation.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Marks the factory as shutting down and waits for all goroutines to terminate.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSync
methods.description: Waits for all started informers' caches to sync using a stop channel.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSyncWithContext
methods.description: Waits for all started informers' caches to sync using a context.

methods.name: InformerFor
methods.description: Returns a shared informer for a given runtime object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ExampleGroup
methods.description: Returns the example interface for the group.
